issues.issue: Is the new evidence (Ministry letter and lawyer's letter on loss of status) admissible under subsection 110(4)?
issues.applicant_position: The letters post-date the rejection and could not reasonably have been anticipated, since the RPD raised the status issue.
issues.result_quote: I disagree with the Appellant's arguments and find that the new evidence does not meet the criteria for acceptance.

issues.issue: Did the RPD err in finding he had not lost his Trinidad and Tobago permanent resident status?
issues.applicant_position: Status is lost after one year's absence without exemption under T&T law; the RPD wrongly required proof he could not regain it.
issues.result_quote: I agree with the Appellant that the RPD erred in its finding that he did not establish that he had lost his status

issues.issue: Is he excluded under Article 1E of the Refugee Convention (Zeng factors)?
issues.applicant_position: The text does not separately state his position on the Zeng factors; he argued that loss of status was established.
issues.result_quote: I cannot make my own findings on these factors, as they were not fully canvassed by the RPD
